policy_basis: Current intent, source count, pinned pairs and remaining server envelope only; no labels or scores.
limits: Same model identity, release, question, source access, scoring and root envelope for all four methods.
Branches partition one root allowance; quotas are not copied.
Role tool restrictions are an internal strategy, not extra data or tool capabilities.
The fixed method retains its historical deterministic sequence and may use less than the common maximum.
Real sources and concurrent execution do not demonstrate real-model quality gains.
No new provider requests are authorized or made by this verification.
